title: Replication package for "Beliefs and Behavior in Language Models"
description: Code to reproduce every figure and table in Smolin and Wilder, "Beliefs and Behavior in Language Models": building the exact prompts from public datasets, collecting LLM responses, strict parsing, fitting latent-belief models, and all evaluations and figures. The prompts, LLM responses, and fitted models are archived in a separate Zenodo record (see README).
